subject.title: fix(memory-core): dreaming narrative subagent receives full generic prompt instead of minimal

question: What permanent plugin runtime contract should support Dreaming-style bare inference while defining which core prompt and safety sections must remain mandatory?
rationale: Neither existing mode matches the requested behavior: `minimal` retains reported noise, while `none` drops the caller’s narrative prompt; selecting or adding the permanent public plugin API semantics requires owner intent.

options.title: Add a bare inference mode
options.body: Define and document a generic mode that includes the caller prompt and only explicitly mandatory core policy, with tools and unrelated bootstrap context disabled.

options.title: Accept reduced minimal mode
options.body: Keep this patch as a partial token reduction while acknowledging that several reported generic sections remain in every narrative request.

options.title: Pause the API expansion
options.body: Leave plugin prompt-mode control internal until the broader plugin subagent prompt and safety contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Add a bare inference mode
recommendation.body: Define and document a generic mode that includes the caller prompt and only explicitly mandatory core policy, with tools and unrelated bootstrap context disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history most directly connects this person to Dreaming and Dream Diary product intent.
